description: Runs a fixture-backed Web platform semantics probe for IndexedDB openCursor(null,'prev'): descending key traversal proving direction handling. The scripted CDP driver observes page output from the self-hosted fixture `/v2/idb/cursor_reverse`, and the server-side grader compares it against the Chrome-baked expected answer. The answer is computed only by executing the IndexedDB operation (it is not present in the static resource); the DB name is isolated per attempt via the `db` query param.
title: IndexedDB openCursor reverse (prev) traversal
